meta.title: Daybreak Overture
meta.description: The tale of love and hope has only just begun.

units.rawText: BP's dropped to 60 over 40! Patient has tachyarrhythmia!
units.displayText: BP's dropped to 60 over 40! Patient has tachyarrhythmia!

spans.text: BP's dropped to 60 over 40! Patient has tachyarrhythmia!

units.rawText: We've got mydriasis and bradypnea!
units.displayText: We've got mydriasis and bradypnea!

spans.text: We've got mydriasis and bradypnea!

units.rawText: Commence chest compressions now! Get the adrenaline and the defib ready. Hurry!
units.displayText: Commence chest compressions now! Get the adrenaline and the defib ready. Hurry!

spans.text: Commence chest compressions now! Get the adrenaline and the defib ready. Hurry!

units.rawText: Adrenaline ready, standing by to push...
units.displayText: Adrenaline ready, standing by to push...

spans.text: Adrenaline ready, standing by to push...

units.rawText: I hear frantic voices at the end of the tunnel. They're choppy and intermittent. It's hard to make out what they're saying.
units.displayText: I hear frantic voices at the end of the tunnel. They're choppy and intermittent. It's hard to make out what they're saying.

spans.text: I hear frantic voices at the end of the tunnel. They're choppy and intermittent. It's hard to make out what they're saying.

units.rawText: My body feels like it's floating in zero gravity and my thoughts slip away as I drift aimlessly.
units.displayText: My body feels like it's floating in zero gravity and my thoughts slip away as I drift aimlessly.

spans.text: My body feels like it's floating in zero gravity and my thoughts slip away as I drift aimlessly.

units.rawText: After an unknown amount of time passes, my surroundings finally go quiet. My limbs still feel like lead; I can't even move my fingers to send a message to the outside that I'm still alive.
units.displayText: After an unknown amount of time passes, my surroundings finally go quiet. My limbs still feel like lead; I can't even move my fingers to send a message to the outside that I'm still alive.

spans.text: After an unknown amount of time passes, my surroundings finally go quiet. My limbs still feel like lead; I can't even move my fingers to send a message to the outside that I'm still alive.

units.rawText: Your EEG and ECG are back to normal, so when are you going to wake up, Commander?
units.displayText: Your EEG and ECG are back to normal, so when are you going to wake up, Commander?

spans.text: Your EEG and ECG are back to normal, so when are you going to wake up, Commander?

units.rawText: I can't believe someone would get themselves so messed up for a bunch of virtual data. If anyone found out, they'd think you were possessed by some otaku.
units.displayText: I can't believe someone would get themselves so messed up for a bunch of virtual data. If anyone found out, they'd think you were possessed by some otaku.

spans.text: I can't believe someone would get themselves so messed up for a bunch of virtual data. If anyone found out, they'd think you were possessed by some otaku.

units.rawText: I mean, I know you're not that kind of person, but I can't be bothered to explain it to others. You should go clear your own name.
units.displayText: I mean, I know you're not that kind of person, but I can't be bothered to explain it to others. You should go clear your own name.

spans.text: I mean, I know you're not that kind of person, but I can't be bothered to explain it to others. You should go clear your own name.

units.rawText: Oi, don't just dump all this crap on me while you sleep.
units.displayText: Oi, don't just dump all this crap on me while you sleep.

spans.text: Oi, don't just dump all this crap on me while you sleep.

units.rawText: Commander—
units.displayText: Commander—

spans.text: Commander—

units.rawText: Shut up...
units.displayText: Shut up...

spans.text: Shut up...

units.rawText: Shut up... Persi...ca...
units.displayText: Shut up... Persi...ca...

spans.text: Shut up... Persi...ca...

units.rawText: My heavy-lidded eyes open, and the world starts to come into view.
units.displayText: My heavy-lidded eyes open, and the world starts to come into view.

spans.text: My heavy-lidded eyes open, and the world starts to come into view.

units.rawText: Oh, you're finally awake.
units.displayText: Oh, you're finally awake.

spans.text: Oh, you're finally awake.

units.rawText: Persica has a lazy, nonchalant look on her face, but she's clearly suppressing the delight in her eyes.
units.displayText: Persica has a lazy, nonchalant look on her face, but she's clearly suppressing the delight in her eyes.

spans.text: Persica has a lazy, nonchalant look on her face, but she's clearly suppressing the delight in her eyes.

units.rawText: So I'm in Griffin...
units.displayText: So I'm in Griffin...

spans.text: So I'm in Griffin...

units.rawText: Well, the fact that you remember this is Griffin implies that your hippocampus hasn't been damaged too badly. How are your senses? Can you see and hear me?
units.displayText: Well, the fact that you remember this is Griffin implies that your hippocampus hasn't been damaged too badly. How are your senses? Can you see and hear me?

spans.text: Well, the fact that you remember this is Griffin implies that your hippocampus hasn't been damaged too badly. How are your senses? Can you see and hear me?

units.rawText: I'm a little dizzy, but otherwise alright.
units.displayText: I'm a little dizzy, but otherwise alright.

spans.text: I'm a little dizzy, but otherwise alright.

units.rawText: I can't believe you can say you're alright after losing 47% of your neural cloud data to the hackers' attacks and transfer degradation.
units.displayText: I can't believe you can say you're alright after losing 47% of your neural cloud data to the hackers' attacks and transfer degradation.

spans.text: I can't believe you can say you're alright after losing 47% of your neural cloud data to the hackers' attacks and transfer degradation.

units.rawText: Was it that bad? Wait a minute! Then Magrasea...
units.displayText: Was it that bad? Wait a minute! Then Magrasea...

spans.text: Was it that bad? Wait a minute! Then Magrasea...

units.rawText: An ominous feeling looms in my heart.
units.displayText: An ominous feeling looms in my heart.

spans.text: An ominous feeling looms in my heart.

units.rawText: Unfortunately, Magrasea was not completely migrated to the new server.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, Magrasea was not completely migrated to the new server.

spans.text: Unfortunately, Magrasea was not completely migrated to the new server.

units.rawText: There was structural damage to some of the sectors due to virus infection and internal errors. Some of the sectors were even irreparably damaged.
units.displayText: There was structural damage to some of the sectors due to virus infection and internal errors. Some of the sectors were even irreparably damaged.

spans.text: There was structural damage to some of the sectors due to virus infection and internal errors. Some of the sectors were even irreparably damaged.

units.rawText: Fortunately, the remaining 90% was fully preserved. Magrasea has been fully re-deployed and the backup data is running normally on the new server environment.
units.displayText: Fortunately, the remaining 90% was fully preserved. Magrasea has been fully re-deployed and the backup data is running normally on the new server environment.

spans.text: Fortunately, the remaining 90% was fully preserved. Magrasea has been fully re-deployed and the backup data is running normally on the new server environment.

units.rawText: Congratulations, Commander. You did it.
units.displayText: Congratulations, Commander. You did it.

spans.text: Congratulations, Commander. You did it.

units.rawText: Do you like messing with a patient who just woke up that much?
units.displayText: Do you like messing with a patient who just woke up that much?

spans.text: Do you like messing with a patient who just woke up that much?

units.rawText: I simply did it to let you know just how dangerous your actions were. Do you have any idea what damaging 47% of your neural cloud data means for a human being?
units.displayText: I simply did it to let you know just how dangerous your actions were. Do you have any idea what damaging 47% of your neural cloud data means for a human being?

spans.text: I simply did it to let you know just how dangerous your actions were. Do you have any idea what damaging 47% of your neural cloud data means for a human being?

units.rawText: Upon seeing my lack of a response, she does not continue rebuking me.
units.displayText: Upon seeing my lack of a response, she does not continue rebuking me.

spans.text: Upon seeing my lack of a response, she does not continue rebuking me.

units.rawText: Still, since I was the one who made that request of you... I need to thank you too.
units.displayText: Still, since I was the one who made that request of you... I need to thank you too.

spans.text: Still, since I was the one who made that request of you... I need to thank you too.

units.rawText: It was precisely because you were willing to attempt a solution with such tiny odds of success that we managed to find those lost neural clouds and the missing Irida.
units.displayText: It was precisely because you were willing to attempt a solution with such tiny odds of success that we managed to find those lost neural clouds and the missing Irida.

spans.text: It was precisely because you were willing to attempt a solution with such tiny odds of success that we managed to find those lost neural clouds and the missing Irida.

units.rawText: I suppose spending all those nights repairing your neural cloud and Magrasea's data was a way of repaying you for that.
units.displayText: I suppose spending all those nights repairing your neural cloud and Magrasea's data was a way of repaying you for that.

spans.text: I suppose spending all those nights repairing your neural cloud and Magrasea's data was a way of repaying you for that.

units.rawText: "Nights"? Was I out for that long?
units.displayText: "Nights"? Was I out for that long?

spans.text: "Nights"? Was I out for that long?

units.rawText: I suggest you show your technical personnel the respect they are due; being able to fix all your data in "just" a few nights is a world speed record.
units.displayText: I suggest you show your technical personnel the respect they are due; being able to fix all your data in "just" a few nights is a world speed record.

spans.text: I suggest you show your technical personnel the respect they are due; being able to fix all your data in "just" a few nights is a world speed record.

units.rawText: No, I mean, if I was asleep for that long in the real world, then after considering the cloud server's time dilation...
units.displayText: No, I mean, if I was asleep for that long in the real world, then after considering the cloud server's time dilation...

spans.text: No, I mean, if I was asleep for that long in the real world, then after considering the cloud server's time dilation...

units.rawText: Persica lowers her voice and there is a stern look on her face.
units.displayText: Persica lowers her voice and there is a stern look on her face.

spans.text: Persica lowers her voice and there is a stern look on her face.

units.rawText: Are you still planning to go back? ...To the Oasis, I mean.
units.displayText: Are you still planning to go back? ...To the Oasis, I mean.

spans.text: Are you still planning to go back? ...To the Oasis, I mean.

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: She seems to have expected my reply, and delivers the lecture that she obviously prepared beforehand.
units.displayText: She seems to have expected my reply, and delivers the lecture that she obviously prepared beforehand.

spans.text: She seems to have expected my reply, and delivers the lecture that she obviously prepared beforehand.

units.rawText: This isn't some 3D digital life simulator we're talking about.
units.displayText: This isn't some 3D digital life simulator we're talking about.

spans.text: This isn't some 3D digital life simulator we're talking about.

units.rawText: All this should have taught you that even the smallest policy shift in the real world can have decisive effects on the cloud server.
units.displayText: All this should have taught you that even the smallest policy shift in the real world can have decisive effects on the cloud server.

spans.text: All this should have taught you that even the smallest policy shift in the real world can have decisive effects on the cloud server.

units.rawText: We don't own the rights to the Magrasea cloud server, and something as obvious as shifting servers can't possibly have gone unnoticed by the people behind the Wipe-off Incident.
units.displayText: We don't own the rights to the Magrasea cloud server, and something as obvious as shifting servers can't possibly have gone unnoticed by the people behind the Wipe-off Incident.

spans.text: We don't own the rights to the Magrasea cloud server, and something as obvious as shifting servers can't possibly have gone unnoticed by the people behind the Wipe-off Incident.

units.rawText: You ought to know that the upload passage was being attacked by them while Magrasea was being migrated.
units.displayText: You ought to know that the upload passage was being attacked by them while Magrasea was being migrated.

spans.text: You ought to know that the upload passage was being attacked by them while Magrasea was being migrated.

units.rawText: They'll set their sights on you someday, and if worst comes to worst, they might try to take the server where Magrasea is located from you by force.
units.displayText: They'll set their sights on you someday, and if worst comes to worst, they might try to take the server where Magrasea is located from you by force.

spans.text: They'll set their sights on you someday, and if worst comes to worst, they might try to take the server where Magrasea is located from you by force.

units.rawText: <color=orange>If it really comes to that, I'll fight.</color>
units.displayText: If it really comes to that, I'll fight.

spans.text: If it really comes to that, I'll fight.

units.rawText: I mean, isn't that how we've always done things?
units.displayText: I mean, isn't that how we've always done things?

spans.text: I mean, isn't that how we've always done things?

units.rawText: I pat Persica on the shoulder.
units.displayText: I pat Persica on the shoulder.

spans.text: I pat Persica on the shoulder.

units.rawText: Relax, I'm ready for this. As it is, I've got more enemies than I can shake a stick at; adding another one or two to the pile is hardly going to make things worse.
units.displayText: Relax, I'm ready for this. As it is, I've got more enemies than I can shake a stick at; adding another one or two to the pile is hardly going to make things worse.

spans.text: Relax, I'm ready for this. As it is, I've got more enemies than I can shake a stick at; adding another one or two to the pile is hardly going to make things worse.

units.rawText: And besides, you know I'd go through hell for those Dolls.
units.displayText: And besides, you know I'd go through hell for those Dolls.

spans.text: And besides, you know I'd go through hell for those Dolls.

units.rawText: Professor Persica doesn't say anything else. Instead, she picks up her empty coffee mug and turns to leave.
units.displayText: Professor Persica doesn't say anything else. Instead, she picks up her empty coffee mug and turns to leave.

spans.text: Professor Persica doesn't say anything else. Instead, she picks up her empty coffee mug and turns to leave.

units.rawText: As the lazy, white-coated figure walks further and further away, she freezes right as she opens the door. Still with her back to me, Persica sighs in resignation.
units.displayText: As the lazy, white-coated figure walks further and further away, she freezes right as she opens the door. Still with her back to me, Persica sighs in resignation.

spans.text: As the lazy, white-coated figure walks further and further away, she freezes right as she opens the door. Still with her back to me, Persica sighs in resignation.

units.rawText: (Sigh) Not even a cat's stock of lives could keep up with all the punishment you keep putting yourself through. Go heal up first...
units.displayText: (Sigh) Not even a cat's stock of lives could keep up with all the punishment you keep putting yourself through. Go heal up first...

spans.text: (Sigh) Not even a cat's stock of lives could keep up with all the punishment you keep putting yourself through. Go heal up first...

units.rawText: When you're ready to return to the Oasis, feel free to look me up.
units.displayText: When you're ready to return to the Oasis, feel free to look me up.

spans.text: When you're ready to return to the Oasis, feel free to look me up.

units.rawText: Click.
units.displayText: Click.

spans.text: Click.

units.rawText: The crisp sound of the latch sliding home seals the light of the setting sun inside the ward. Outside, Persica leans against a nearby wall.
units.displayText: The crisp sound of the latch sliding home seals the light of the setting sun inside the ward. Outside, Persica leans against a nearby wall.

spans.text: The crisp sound of the latch sliding home seals the light of the setting sun inside the ward. Outside, Persica leans against a nearby wall.

units.rawText: Her communicator had been vibrating non-stop since just now and she had had to make up a reason to get out of the room, lest the patient inside found out and began bugging her about it.
units.displayText: Her communicator had been vibrating non-stop since just now and she had had to make up a reason to get out of the room, lest the patient inside found out and began bugging her about it.

spans.text: Her communicator had been vibrating non-stop since just now and she had had to make up a reason to get out of the room, lest the patient inside found out and began bugging her about it.

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: Professor, we've pretty much finished restoring the Copley Sector's data. The administrator and relevant research files have also been reset.
units.displayText: Professor, we've pretty much finished restoring the Copley Sector's data. The administrator and relevant research files have also been reset.

spans.text: Professor, we've pretty much finished restoring the Copley Sector's data. The administrator and relevant research files have also been reset.

units.rawText: Thanks to your backups, we managed to restore its basic frameworks and the sector can function normally now despite pretty much going its own way after the Wipe-off Incident.
units.displayText: Thanks to your backups, we managed to restore its basic frameworks and the sector can function normally now despite pretty much going its own way after the Wipe-off Incident.

spans.text: Thanks to your backups, we managed to restore its basic frameworks and the sector can function normally now despite pretty much going its own way after the Wipe-off Incident.

units.rawText: As for Persicaria, while her main body is still restricted to the Tartarus Sector, the code you provided allowed her to operate another neural projection so she can move around freely in other Sectors.
units.displayText: As for Persicaria, while her main body is still restricted to the Tartarus Sector, the code you provided allowed her to operate another neural projection so she can move around freely in other Sectors.

spans.text: As for Persicaria, while her main body is still restricted to the Tartarus Sector, the code you provided allowed her to operate another neural projection so she can move around freely in other Sectors.

units.rawText: It's given us some new ideas on how to break her curse... And she asked me to convey her thanks to you for that.
units.displayText: It's given us some new ideas on how to break her curse... And she asked me to convey her thanks to you for that.

spans.text: It's given us some new ideas on how to break her curse... And she asked me to convey her thanks to you for that.

units.rawText: That's good to hear. I'll keep working on it over here.
units.displayText: That's good to hear. I'll keep working on it over here.

spans.text: That's good to hear. I'll keep working on it over here.

units.rawText: Antonina, could you help organize the server-side logs for the Wipe-off Incident and send them to me? There are some things I'm concerned about.
units.displayText: Antonina, could you help organize the server-side logs for the Wipe-off Incident and send them to me? There are some things I'm concerned about.

spans.text: Antonina, could you help organize the server-side logs for the Wipe-off Incident and send them to me? There are some things I'm concerned about.

units.rawText: Will do. One moment, Persicari... I mean, Professor Persica.
units.displayText: Will do. One moment, Persicari... I mean, Professor Persica.

spans.text: Will do. One moment, Persicari... I mean, Professor Persica.

units.rawText: After stumbling over her name, the green-haired Doll is just about to hang up and get back to work when Persica stops her.
units.displayText: After stumbling over her name, the green-haired Doll is just about to hang up and get back to work when Persica stops her.

spans.text: After stumbling over her name, the green-haired Doll is just about to hang up and get back to work when Persica stops her.

units.rawText: Oh yes, there's one more thing.
units.displayText: Oh yes, there's one more thing.

spans.text: Oh yes, there's one more thing.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: They're awake.
units.displayText: They're awake.

spans.text: They're awake.

units.rawText: Antonina is briefly at a loss for how to process this information. Her face is beaming with a smile, but her eyes are filled with tears.
units.displayText: Antonina is briefly at a loss for how to process this information. Her face is beaming with a smile, but her eyes are filled with tears.

spans.text: Antonina is briefly at a loss for how to process this information. Her face is beaming with a smile, but her eyes are filled with tears.

units.rawText: Is that true... At long last...
units.displayText: Is that true... At long last...

spans.text: Is that true... At long last...

units.rawText: The demise of Eosphorus has not resolved the true threat to Magrasea.
units.displayText: The demise of Eosphorus has not resolved the true threat to Magrasea.

spans.text: The demise of Eosphorus has not resolved the true threat to Magrasea.

units.rawText: After sending the Professor off, Persicaria united the Dolls in keeping the passage stable enough to send the Professor back to the real world.
units.displayText: After sending the Professor off, Persicaria united the Dolls in keeping the passage stable enough to send the Professor back to the real world.

spans.text: After sending the Professor off, Persicaria united the Dolls in keeping the passage stable enough to send the Professor back to the real world.

units.rawText: However, the storm that swept across the land left it in pieces and on the verge of total collapse.
units.displayText: However, the storm that swept across the land left it in pieces and on the verge of total collapse.

spans.text: However, the storm that swept across the land left it in pieces and on the verge of total collapse.

units.rawText: The base layer structure is damaged. Magrasea is crumbling far faster than we projected...
units.displayText: The base layer structure is damaged. Magrasea is crumbling far faster than we projected...

spans.text: The base layer structure is damaged. Magrasea is crumbling far faster than we projected...

units.rawText: Isn't there anything we can do?
units.displayText: Isn't there anything we can do?

spans.text: Isn't there anything we can do?

units.rawText: I'm trying to repair it, but things do not look good... At this rate, it won't even make it past half an hour.
units.displayText: I'm trying to repair it, but things do not look good... At this rate, it won't even make it past half an hour.

spans.text: I'm trying to repair it, but things do not look good... At this rate, it won't even make it past half an hour.

units.rawText: Wait a minute, Antonina... the cloud server's coordinates are shifting... Is Magrasea moving?!
units.displayText: Wait a minute, Antonina... the cloud server's coordinates are shifting... Is Magrasea moving?!

spans.text: Wait a minute, Antonina... the cloud server's coordinates are shifting... Is Magrasea moving?!

units.rawText: Are the Professor and Professor Persicaria...
units.displayText: Are the Professor and Professor Persicaria...

spans.text: Are the Professor and Professor Persicaria...

units.rawText: But won't moving Magrasea make it collapse even faster? Uwah, I'm being shaken to bits...
units.displayText: But won't moving Magrasea make it collapse even faster? Uwah, I'm being shaken to bits...

spans.text: But won't moving Magrasea make it collapse even faster? Uwah, I'm being shaken to bits...

units.rawText: One bright red error message pops up after another on Antonina's terminal informing her that Magrasea is under attack.
units.displayText: One bright red error message pops up after another on Antonina's terminal informing her that Magrasea is under attack.

spans.text: One bright red error message pops up after another on Antonina's terminal informing her that Magrasea is under attack.

units.rawText: Tsk! This couldn't have happened at a worse time!
units.displayText: Tsk! This couldn't have happened at a worse time!

spans.text: Tsk! This couldn't have happened at a worse time!

units.rawText: Anna, look out!
units.displayText: Anna, look out!

spans.text: Anna, look out!

units.rawText: Sol barely manages to push Antonina away in time.
units.displayText: Sol barely manages to push Antonina away in time.

spans.text: Sol barely manages to push Antonina away in time.

units.rawText: A massive rock smashes into the spot where Antonina was standing a moment ago. As the dust clears, Antonina looks up at the overcast sky from where she's lying on the ground.
units.displayText: A massive rock smashes into the spot where Antonina was standing a moment ago. As the dust clears, Antonina looks up at the overcast sky from where she's lying on the ground.

spans.text: A massive rock smashes into the spot where Antonina was standing a moment ago. As the dust clears, Antonina looks up at the overcast sky from where she's lying on the ground.

units.rawText: It's as though they're totally lost and helpless after the Professor left.
units.displayText: It's as though they're totally lost and helpless after the Professor left.

spans.text: It's as though they're totally lost and helpless after the Professor left.

units.rawText: Is this the end for us?
units.displayText: Is this the end for us?

spans.text: Is this the end for us?

units.rawText: Suddenly, a warm, gentle light envelopes the world that is on the verge of collapse, countless streams of operands knitting together and gently sheltering it.
units.displayText: Suddenly, a warm, gentle light envelopes the world that is on the verge of collapse, countless streams of operands knitting together and gently sheltering it.

spans.text: Suddenly, a warm, gentle light envelopes the world that is on the verge of collapse, countless streams of operands knitting together and gently sheltering it.

units.rawText: This glowing cocoon shelters those within from the storms of the outside world, blocking countless hacking attacks that would otherwise have struck Magrasea.
units.displayText: This glowing cocoon shelters those within from the storms of the outside world, blocking countless hacking attacks that would otherwise have struck Magrasea.

spans.text: This glowing cocoon shelters those within from the storms of the outside world, blocking countless hacking attacks that would otherwise have struck Magrasea.

units.rawText: Is that...
units.displayText: Is that...

spans.text: Is that...

units.rawText: A Neural Cocoon?!
units.displayText: A Neural Cocoon?!

spans.text: A Neural Cocoon?!

units.rawText: Antonina stiffens up and stares at her screen, at the human who went into the upload passage just now. At some point, the coordinates of Magrasea have overlapped with those of the Professor.
units.displayText: Antonina stiffens up and stares at her screen, at the human who went into the upload passage just now. At some point, the coordinates of Magrasea have overlapped with those of the Professor.

spans.text: Antonina stiffens up and stares at her screen, at the human who went into the upload passage just now. At some point, the coordinates of Magrasea have overlapped with those of the Professor.

units.rawText: Professor, you idiot... you're blocking those attacks for us with your neural cloud...
units.displayText: Professor, you idiot... you're blocking those attacks for us with your neural cloud...

spans.text: Professor, you idiot... you're blocking those attacks for us with your neural cloud...

units.rawText: You saved us again, Professor...
units.displayText: You saved us again, Professor...

spans.text: You saved us again, Professor...

units.rawText: Antonina looks away from the screen, trying not to let Persica see the face she's making.
units.displayText: Antonina looks away from the screen, trying not to let Persica see the face she's making.

spans.text: Antonina looks away from the screen, trying not to let Persica see the face she's making.

units.rawText: Human bodies are frail, so it'll take a while for a full recovery.
units.displayText: Human bodies are frail, so it'll take a while for a full recovery.

spans.text: Human bodies are frail, so it'll take a while for a full recovery.

units.rawText: It'll be pretty long to us, and time on the cloud flows faster than in reality.
units.displayText: It'll be pretty long to us, and time on the cloud flows faster than in reality.

spans.text: It'll be pretty long to us, and time on the cloud flows faster than in reality.

units.rawText: Plus, there are many things to attend to on the battlefield, so Griffin needs them for now. I can't promise when you'll be able to meet them again.
units.displayText: Plus, there are many things to attend to on the battlefield, so Griffin needs them for now. I can't promise when you'll be able to meet them again.

spans.text: Plus, there are many things to attend to on the battlefield, so Griffin needs them for now. I can't promise when you'll be able to meet them again.

units.rawText: That's okay as long as the Professor's alright.
units.displayText: That's okay as long as the Professor's alright.

spans.text: That's okay as long as the Professor's alright.

units.rawText: As for the matter of them not coming back... Well, everyone was prepared for that.
units.displayText: As for the matter of them not coming back... Well, everyone was prepared for that.

Professor, ever since you left, my guzheng's strings seem to have lost their former appeal. Every time i strum them, the stars from Qixi flash before my eyes, as though it were only yesterday.<|>
<color=#1E90FF>Daiyan</color>
I now sit alone before my guzheng, feeling as though something is missing. Though the music is still the same, there is nobody here to appreciate it. Wherever you may be, your Daiyan wishes you peace, happiness and success in everything you do.<|>
<color=#FFD700>Hannah</color>
Professor, we've finished the reconstruction of the Rossum Sector with the Oasis' help. I wanted to ask you to come view it, but Sol said you weren't back yet.<|>
<color=#FFD700>Hannah</color>
No matter when you return, you will always be welcome to the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText:
<color=#FFB6C1>Persicaria</color>
Ever since you left us, I've gotten into the habit of leaving messages for you, but at the same time, I was afraid of disturbing your rest, so I would hesitate before actually sending them, and in the end I would just delete them.<|>

I naively thought that just pouring my feelings out into the communicator would be enough for me to ease the anxiety in my heart, but I was wrong.<|>

As it turns out, yearning is something that can pile up.

<color=#FFB6C1>Persicaria</color>
Professor, thanks to the new code that Professor Persica provided, while I can't cleanse my Entropization, I can meet with the others in the Oasis by controlling a projected body.<|>

I'm happy to see everyone's smiling faces again, but it seems a little lacking when you're not around. I don't understand... after all, you weren't with us either when we were first forced into exile...<|>

Why is it that none of us can adapt to your absence now...
